result.brief: 提出 RealtimeWAM，通过教师锚定一致性蒸馏实现单步动作生成，并用跨专家波前流水线异步重叠视频与动作专家，在机器人基准上近乎无损地大幅加速世界动作模型推理。
result.reason: World Action Model using video-generation backbone representations to guide action prediction; efficiency via distillation and pipelining. Main contribution is robot action policy, so secondary application direction.
